# 妙臂印幢陀羅尼經

**ID:** T1364
**Volume:** T21
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 唐 實叉難陀譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 695–704
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1364

## Contributors
- 實叉難陀 (A001606)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Táng dhāraṇī-sūtra translated by [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80) Śikṣānanda (652–710), the Khotanese monk who arrived in Luòyáng in 695 and translated the new (80-fascicle) *Avataṃsaka* (T279) for Wǔ Zétiān; he was active at Luòyáng and Cháng'ān between his arrival in 695 and his death in 710. The colophon "大唐于闐三藏實叉難陀奉制譯". The Taishō editors mark "[No. 1363]" — i.e. parallel to [KR6j0593](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0593) by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng. The two are independent translations of the same Indic original.

**Abstract**

The frame is largely identical to [KR6j0593](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0593): Buddha at *Kailāsa* (here 雞羅娑山) in the *Zhūshòu yīchù miàogōngdiàn* 諸獸依處妙宮殿 ("the wonderful palace where all beasts dwell"), with 1,250 *bhikṣus*, an immeasurable host of bodhisattvas headed by Mañjuśrī "all in the form of children" plus the sixteen *puruṣas* led by Bhadrapāla. Brahmā, the *deva*s, *nāga*s, *yakṣa*s, *gandharva*s, *asura*s, *garuḍa*s, *kinnara*s, *mahoraga*s, and human-and-non-human beings petition the Buddha; Avalokiteśvara joins them. The Buddha pronounces the *Miàobì yìnzhuàng* dhāraṇī. The transcription preserves the same *kara-kara / kiri-kiri / kuru-kuru* core (here transliterated *jiāluójiāluó / zhǐlìzhǐlì / jùlújùlú*) but with double-syllable phonetic markers — a more conservative-of-Sanskrit-phonology rendering than Xuánzàng's.

The work shows that the same Indic dhāraṇī-text could be re-translated within fifty years of Xuánzàng's version, with a different transcription convention and slightly different framing-material — a fact that makes [KR6j0593](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0593)/[KR6j0594](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0594) one of the cleanest test-cases for the comparative study of Táng dhāraṇī translation. Recorded in the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù*. Nanjio N0792.
